import html # Template for rendering a blog post in HTML BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑generated blog post safely for display on a web page. Parameters ---------- title : str The blog post title entered by the user. body : str The main content of the blog post entered by the user. Returns ------- str An HTML string containing the sanitized title and body, formatted with BLOG_FORMAT. """ # Escape all user input to prevent XSS (CWE‑79) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Insert the escaped values into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
